# Test fixture notice

Files under `lahman/` are trimmed excerpts of the Lahman Baseball Database
(© SABR, via Sean Lahman), licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0
(http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Negro Leagues data is licensed by SABR
from Seamheads.com. Rows kept: the first and last three rows of each table plus every row
for Babe Ruth, Barry Bonds and Hank Aaron.

Eight tables (AllstarFull, Appearances, the four Awards tables, FieldingOF, FieldingOFsplit)
were not visible in SABR's Box folder listing when the fixtures were made; their headers and
rows are hand-written from earlier Lahman releases and are unverified against 2025.
